snippet.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Overview Trailer — Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game launches September 17, 2026, only on Nintendo Switch 2. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/fire-emblem-fortunes-weave-switch-2/

Travel through time to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor. Test your tactical prowess in battle as you guide four heroes on their interwoven journeys from past to present. Together, you’ll save the future from ruin—or fall trying.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
